architecture.world_model: grounded historical replay only; no learned latent dynamics
architecture.jev_role: optional bounded SystemOne advisory layer; shadow-first; no promotion or execution authority
architecture.policy_interface: one AdaptiveReplayPolicy shared by replay and live adapters
architecture.qualification: immutable replay splits + worst-world gate + repeated paired real canary
architecture.execution: strict fail-closed Bubblewrap or Docker/Podman OCI sandbox; insecure process mode only by explicit opt-in
architecture.parallelism: effective live parallelism 1; replay parallel bonus 0

v1_3_upgrades: serialized JEV node evidence and replay-world schema v3

validation.original_full_pytest: not collectable in build environment because inherited AIDE runtime dependencies humanize, backoff, and dataclasses_json are not installed
validation.llm2jev_full_pytest: not collectable in build environment because optional dependency openai is not installed
validation.strict_backend_execution: not executed in build container; command construction/fail-closed behavior covered by inherited RSI tests
validation.live_jev_backend: not executed; adapter validated against typed mocks and bundled fabric unit tests

known_limitations: replay cannot generate unseen branch outcomes
failure influence is explicit opt-in and depends on backend calibration quality
bundled LocalJevFabric does not contain TypeSafe Jev weights
strict sandbox execution must be integration-tested on the deployment host
